item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes rin chen gter gyi sgo 'byed gsang don gsal ba'i a dar+sha
item.coloph: zhes bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes rin chen gter gyi sgo 'byed gsang don gsal ba'i a dar+sha zhes bya ba 'di nyid grub thob spa'i rigs las sku 'khrungs pa sprul pa'i gter ston gar dbang o rgyan rad+na gling pa'am/ ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma gang de'i 'di'i rgyud gzhung cha lag dang bcas pa dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo nas spyan drangs shing rten 'brel sgo ma 'gag par shog ser bod yig tu gtan la phabs nas/ gzhung 'di'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes rgyas pa zhig bris zhes pa'i bka' yis bskul ba mdzad pa dang / nye bar bla ma tshul khrims dbang rgyal dang gter slob tshul khrims blo ldan zung nas rin chen maN Dal bzang po dang rab dkar lha rdzas bcas kyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul ngor/ spa rigs su dal rten rnyed pa'i gshen gyi dge sbyong ming 'dzin g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po'am brda sprod pa'i btags ming 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ge dbyangs can dgyes pa'i zla ba legs bshad bdud rtsi'i 'od snang zhes 'bod pas dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzang por bris rgyang ri dmar pad brag lha rtse'i zhol 'dabs su bgyis te/ yi ge dang po'i byed po 'gru bon lhun grub rgyal mtshan nas bris pa'i dge des zab gsang theg pa chen po'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che rgya mtsho'i gos can mtha' dag tu khyab pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
